# jdbc-shard-router

> JDBC shard router that routes statements by shard key with jump consistent hashing and merges scatter-gather results for ORDER BY, LIMIT, GROUP BY and aggregates Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:jdbc-shard-router`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.jdbc_shard_router`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
